newsitem.title: POLAND: CU to launch non-life insurance in Poland.
newsitem.headline: CU to launch non-life insurance in Poland.

text.p: Britain's Commercial Union Plc, whose life insurance subsidary has operated in Poland since 1992, will launch a non-life insurance firm in January 1997, CU's Polish unit president said on Thursday.
Marian Miziolek told Reuters in an interview that the new company, in which CU holds 90 percent and Polish Wielkopolski Bank Kredytowy (WBK) 10 percent, would initially focus on industrial insurance.
"We will start non-life insurance operations from January 1997," he said. @
He said the company, named Commercial Union Towarzystwo Ubezpieczen Ogolnych Polska SA, will later offer automobile, home and other smaller-scale insurances.
The firm's share capital is 10 million zlotys.

Miziolek said CU had had the finance ministry licence to provide both life and non-life insurance since 1991 but that it needed several years to prepare operations in the more difficult non-life sector.
